name: 0059 - RFC 0065 Slice 2 shell layout & information hierarchy

jobs.title: Re-flow the three-region shell onto Slice 1 tokens and one typographic hierarchy
jobs.objective: Re-flow the three-region web shell (region-params / region-geometry / region-review), the toolbar, the four status-bar segments (package / readiness / resistance / cfd), and the Generate panel (build / watch / pick) onto the Slice 1 theme tokens (SPACING / DENSITY / RADII / ELEVATION / BORDERS / focus-ring / state) and one typographic hierarchy using the existing TYPOGRAPHY roles (type-display / type-heading / type-label / type-body / type-caption / type-metric), applied consistently so heading weight signals section importance the same way in every panel, with consistent section rhythm and card/strip density. Touch kayakgen/ui/web/app.py and the Generate-panel modules (generate_spec_form.py, generate_frontier_view.py, generate_fork_button.py, generate_state_listener.py); style only through tokens — add no new inline dimension/radius/elevation/border/colour literal (the widened tests/test_ui_theme.py orphan lint stays green). If a genuine token gap appears, add it ADDITIVELY to kayakgen/ui/theme.py per Slice 1 D1 (rename/remove/re-type no existing token) and extend CONTRAST_MANIFEST + the lint accordingly. Preserve the 1440x900 first-viewport contract (full Parameters rail, 3D viewport, metrics strip, first Review tab, status bar) and the <=960px collapse behaviour (kg-collapse-under-960, kg-geometry-accordion-under-960, kg-review-body-under-960, kg-status-wrap-under-960) — restyle the collapse, do not remove it; conservative mobile posture, no new mobile-editing affordance. Keep the region-params/-geometry/-review data-testids and the four status segments (data-testid workspace-status-bar + status-{package,readiness,resistance,cfd}). Any other data-testid/kg-* hook MAY be renamed/moved/removed but EVERY such change MUST be reflected in tests/test_web_layout.py (and tests/test_web_inline_help.py if an inline-help hook moves) in this slice. Claim line is byte-stable: touch no CHIP_SPECS/CHIP_LABELS/CHIP_CLASSES text or class, recolour no chip, keep every persistent caption (resistance, high-angle GZ, CFD local/artifact, not-watertight-cfd_ready) byte-identical, keep the RFC 0033 section 8 no-go list absent. Add no REST route or claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal (RFC 0032 boundary). Docs: CHANGELOG.md only; do NOT touch docs/USER_GUIDE.md or docs/WEB_VERIFICATION.md (Slice 4); do not ratify DECISION_LOG D047. See SLICE_2_DECISIONS.md D1-D8.

jobs.title: Review traceability to RFC 0065 Slice 2 decisions
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0059 change for traceability to RFC 0065 section 2 and SLICE_2_DECISIONS.md (D1-D8). Flag scope creep: any token re-typing/removal (Slice 1 boundary), any control-state or empty/loading/error-state change (Slice 3), any harness or WEB_VERIFICATION.md/USER_GUIDE.md change or D047 ratification (Slice 4), any touched CHIP_* entry or persistent caption, any recoloured chip, any new REST route/claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal. Confirm styling is token-only (no new inline dimension/colour literal; orphan lint green); the typographic hierarchy uses the TYPOGRAPHY roles consistently; the region-params/-geometry/-review test-ids and the four status segments survive; the 1440x900 first-viewport contract and the <=960px collapse hooks hold; and EVERY renamed/moved/removed data-testid/kg-* hook is reflected in tests/test_web_layout.py (and test_web_inline_help.py where relevant).

jobs.title: Review claims and user-facing boundaries
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0059 change for claim truthfulness. Confirm CHIP_SPECS/CHIP_LABELS/CHIP_CLASSES text and semantic class are byte-identical and no chip is recoloured into the success palette; every persistent caption (resistance 'Raw comparative filter; not final prediction.' and uncalibrated copy; the high-angle GZ caption; the CFD local-jobs and raw-artifact banners; the not-watertight-cfd_ready negation) is byte-identical after the reflow; no new claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal and no new REST route (RFC 0032 boundary); the RFC 0033 section 8 no-go list stays absent from rendered output; and the reflow did not move an unvalidated/raw result into a position or treatment that reads as a confident/validated/calibrated claim. New or moved ARIA labels and tooltips carry no claim semantics.

jobs.title: Review tests, determinism, and operational behaviour
jobs.objective: Review workflow 0059 tests for determinism and coverage. Confirm tests/test_web_layout.py reflects EVERY renamed/moved/removed data-testid/kg-* hook (no orphaned assertion against a hook that no longer exists, and a positive assertion for each new hook name); the region-params/-geometry/-review test-ids and the four status segments (status-package/readiness/resistance/cfd + workspace-status-bar) still assert; the 1440x900 first-viewport and the <=960px collapse hooks are asserted; tests/test_web_inline_help.py reflects any moved inline-help hook; the widened orphan-literal lint (tests/test_ui_theme.py) still passes (token-only styling, no new inline dimension/colour literal); the desktop rendered-bbox tests stay green; and the full repo suite minus env-gated smoke is green with git diff --check, the forbidden-copy scan, and the import-boundary scans passing. Tests must not depend on wall-clock sleeps.

jobs.title: Build findings ledger
jobs.objective: Deduplicate the three review findings into must-fix remediation items and non-blocking successor items (pointing at a later RFC 0065 slice where appropriate) without inventing new design scope. Cross-check each finding against SLICE_2_DECISIONS.md; a finding that would reopen a settled decision belongs in the non-blocking successor bucket with an explicit pointer to the row it would override.

jobs.title: Remediate review findings
jobs.objective: Fix the must-fix findings from the ledger, update CHANGELOG.md and this workflow's OPERATOR_REPORT.md, and preserve all SLICE_2_DECISIONS.md decisions and the no-claims boundaries (token-only styling, byte-stable claim line, region + status + collapse contract intact, every hook change reflected in the layout tests, USER_GUIDE.md/WEB_VERIFICATION.md untouched, D047 not ratified). Run tests/test_web_layout.py, tests/test_web_inline_help.py, tests/test_ui_theme.py, the desktop rendered-bbox tests, and the full repo suite minus the env-gated smoke before publishing.

jobs.title: Final review workflow 0059
jobs.objective: Final-review workflow 0059 for accepted Slice 2 scope, decision fidelity (D1-D8), and no-claims boundaries. Confirm the shell, toolbar, four status segments, and Generate panel re-flowed onto Slice 1 tokens and one TYPOGRAPHY hierarchy; styling is token-only (orphan lint green); the region-params/-geometry/-review test-ids and four status segments survive; the 1440x900 first-viewport contract and <=960px collapse hold; every renamed/moved hook is reflected in tests/test_web_layout.py (+ test_web_inline_help.py); the claim line and RFC 0032 boundary are intact; USER_GUIDE.md/WEB_VERIFICATION.md were not touched and D047 was not ratified; and the full repo suite minus env-gated smoke is green.
